Know Before You Go

How to Stay Informed

For the most accurate and up-to-date information about conditions, lift status, and trail openings:

  1. Download the Dodge Ridge App
    • Get live updates on weather, road conditions, and lifts and trail status.
  2. Check Our Snow Report Page
    • Visit dodge ridge.com/snowreport for daily details on snow totals, weather forecasts, road conditions, and planned chair openings.
  3. Follow Us on Social Media
    • Stay connected and informed by following us on Instagram and Facebook for real-time updates, photos, and announcements.
    Snow phone (209) 536-5300

    For updates please be sure to check back here or you can also

    • Call our 24 hour snow phone line at (209) 536-5300.
    • Check the Dodge Ridge Social Media Channels. ( Facebook & Instagram) 

    Feel free to send us an email to info@example.com.
